response.text: {"label": "timing_arithmetic", "reason": "The sub times bits with #(PRESCALE_VAL*8) = 40 time units, which is only 5 clock cycles, instead of prescale*8 = 40 cycles, so frames are mis-sampled; it shows only short busy pulses (`3 ... rx busy_rise`, `23 ... rx busy_fall`) and never a handshake (gold `137 ... rx hs 3c`), and wait(m_axis_tvalid) then hangs until timeout."}
